purpose: Separate compact storage of one GF(2) linear clause from the genuinely global union-cover problem. Reinterpret each ordinary CNF clause as the complement of one low-codimension coordinate affine subspace. Show that although every single forbidden subspace and every single intersection have polynomial RREF descriptions, the distinct intersection closure can contain 2^m states already for a trivially satisfiable family of m disjoint 3-clauses. This rules out naive inclusion-exclusion/intersection-lattice saturation as a polynomial universal solver.

linear_clause_geometry.res_xor_line: A Res(oplus) linear clause (L_1=b_1) OR ... OR (L_k=b_k) is false exactly on the affine solution set L_1=1-b_1,...,L_k=1-b_k. Thus its falsifying set is one affine subspace/coset represented canonically by an RREF augmented matrix of rank at most n.
linear_clause_geometry.ordinary_clause: For an ordinary clause C=(ell_1 OR ... OR ell_t), t<=3, S_C is the coordinate affine subspace obtained by fixing every variable in C to the unique value making its literal false. Then assignment a satisfies C iff a is not in S_C.
linear_clause_geometry.global_equivalence: For F=AND_C C, SAT(F) iff GF(2)^n minus UNION_C S_C is nonempty. Equivalently, UNSAT(F) iff the low-codimension forbidden affine subspaces cover the whole Boolean cube.
linear_clause_geometry.compactness: One S_C has codimension at most three. Any intersection of chosen S_C is either inconsistent or another affine subspace with a canonical O(n^2)-bit RREF description. Wide linear clauses themselves therefore need not cause an exponential representation blowup.

exponential_intersection_family.formula: For m>=1 let F_m=AND_{j=1}^m (x_{3j-2} OR x_{3j-1} OR x_{3j}) on n=3m pairwise disjoint variable triples.
exponential_intersection_family.satisfiability: F_m is trivially satisfiable, for example by the all-ones assignment.
exponential_intersection_family.forbidden_space: S_j fixes exactly x_{3j-2}=x_{3j-1}=x_{3j}=0 and leaves all other variables free.
exponential_intersection_family.intersection: For every T subseteq [m], S_T=INTERSECTION_{j in T} S_j fixes precisely the 3|T| variables belonging to triples in T to zero.
exponential_intersection_family.theorem: All 2^m spaces S_T are nonempty and pairwise distinct; rank/codimension(S_T)=3|T|. Their canonical RREF descriptions are therefore also pairwise distinct.
proof: The clause triples are variable-disjoint, so the defining equations from different S_j are linearly independent and never inconsistent.
Hence S_T has exactly the 3|T| independent coordinate equations belonging to T.
If T differs from U, choose j in their symmetric difference. The three variables of block j are fixed to zero in exactly one of S_T,S_U, so the two affine spaces differ.
There are 2^m subsets T, hence 2^m distinct intersection states although the input contains only m clauses and is immediately satisfiable.

killed: Any claimed polynomial SAT algorithm that explicitly materializes every distinct affine intersection generated by the clause-falsifying spaces.
Naive exact inclusion-exclusion over the intersection lattice of forbidden affine subspaces.
Canonical-RREF memoization as a sufficient argument for polynomiality: canonical states can still be exponentially numerous.
not_killed: Res(oplus) or another proof system that derives only a polynomially small selected subset of linear clauses/intersections.
A polynomial-size sketch/minimax invariant deciding whether UNION_C S_C covers GF(2)^n without enumerating the intersection lattice.
Formula-dependent cancellation that aggregates exponentially many intersections implicitly.
scoped_barrier.firewall: This is an enumeration lower bound for a specific state-expansion strategy, not a lower bound on all Res(oplus) proofs or all affine-subspace algorithms.

relation_to_v4_1.macaulay: The degree-3 GF2 Macaulay kernel captures low-degree polynomial combinations, including native parity contradictions. The affine-union view instead keeps arbitrary-rank individual affine falsifying systems compact and identifies the next global bottleneck as union-cover/noncover.
relation_to_v4_1.bijunctive_affine: The OR3-to-2CNF+XOR3 gadget proves arbitrary 3-SAT already lives in a coupled affine/bijunctive vocabulary. The present theorem explains why merely canonicalizing affine pieces does not remove the combinatorial explosion.

next_target.name: E8_AFFINE_UNION_COVER_POLYNOMIAL_SKETCH_OR_MINIMAX_V4_5
next_target.directive: Do not enumerate intersections. Seek a polynomial-size exact invariant for whether low-codimension clause-falsifying affine subspaces cover GF(2)^n, exploiting implication closure and degree-3 Macaulay consequences already extracted. Any candidate must distinguish full cover from noncover, reconstruct an uncovered assignment in polynomial time, and survive the disjoint-clause 2^m-intersection control without expanding those states. Alternatively prove a scoped lower bound for a precisely defined sketch class.
success_obligations: no hidden exponential rank family, Fourier support, or oracle

sources: D. Itsykson and D. Sokolov, Resolution over linear equations modulo two, Annals of Pure and Applied Logic 171(1), 2020, 102722.
